Makes twelve rolls.

![Rolls on a tray](../../../attachments/e2/e24f615689c51a90fce260edbb6b16e9e27db8ce9a60ba360c189e1e7ded433f.jpg)

1. Mix
2. Knead
   1. ten minutes
3. Bake at 230 °C
